lines.text: Jesus says He has come to ignite a fire on the earth and has a baptism to undergo.
Jesus says He has come to bring rest to the earth, and households will be divided.
Jesus tells the crowds they say a shower is coming when they see a cloud rising in the west.
When the south wind blows, the crowds say it will be cold, yet they cannot interpret the present time.
Jesus says to reconcile with your adversary, or you may be thrown into prison until you pay the last penny.
